bullets.text: Highlight Reels for Xbox Ally X - Xbox Insiders can now access new highlight reels feature via the Xbox PC app.
Effortless Keyboard Navigation - Microsoft addresses accessibility issues in web navigation for keyboard users.
Empowering Women in Cybersecurity - Microsoft highlights the importance of diversity in cybersecurity during Women's History Month.
Malicious AI Extensions Detected - Microsoft Defender uncovers browser extensions harvesting sensitive data from users.
Copilot App Enhancements - New features in the Copilot App allow seamless web link access alongside conversations.
Azure IaaS Resource Center Launched - Microsoft introduces a centralized hub for infrastructure design and optimization.
Tycoon2FA Phishing Kit Analysis - Microsoft reveals insights into the widespread phishing-as-a-service platform.
GitHub Copilot CLI Course Available - A free course helps developers leverage GitHub Copilot CLI for enhanced productivity.
Signed Malware Campaigns Identified - Microsoft Defender uncovers signed malware impersonating workplace applications.
Instant Access Snapshots in Azure - New feature allows immediate restoration of disks from incremental snapshots.
